notes: Dev-time eval set for skill authoring. Fixtures are described by SHAPE so the set is not tied to any one checkout; `example_fixture` points at a copy in the AutoProver repository, but a runner may supply an equivalent. Each eval runs against a fresh COPY of its fixture, because the flow edits the crate and writes certora/ artifacts. Evals 1-2 need CERTORAKEY and submit real cloud prover jobs; the prover's share is cheap, the agent's tokens are the cost. Eval 3 is offline and fails at setup.

evals.name: anchor-vault-end-to-end
evals.prompt: Formally verify the Solana program in <project> with the Certora prover — come up with properties for it and prove them.
evals.fixture: A small Anchor workspace with one program: a vault with initialize, deposit and withdraw instructions over a vault account that records an owner and a balance. No pre-existing certora/ directory or src/certora/ module.
evals.expected_output: certora-cvlr toolchain all ok; setup scaffolds the crate and declares one module per component plus invariants and invariant_rules; certora/analysis/application.json names the instructions and the vault account; properties per component include a signer/owner check on withdraw and balance accounting on deposit and withdraw; Phase 5 proves at least one structural invariant with a base case and one step per writer, all VERIFIED; each component's full prove is clean or its failures are marked; certora/report/report.md lists setup's edits and links every job.
assertions: certora/logs/setup.log exists and the crate's Cargo.toml has a certora feature
src/certora/specs/invariants.rs holds predicates and no #[rule], and invariant_rules.rs holds the base cases and steps
every component module was checked with `certora-cvlr check` and proved with `certora-cvlr prove`, never with a hand-written conf or cargo command
a property that withdraw rejects a signer who is not the owner exists and is mapped to a rule
report.md states the per-outcome counts, lists setup's edits to the crate, and links the prover jobs

evals.name: planted-bug-surfaces-finding
evals.prompt: Formally verify <project> with the Certora Solana prover. I want real verification results, not just rules.
evals.fixture: A small Anchor program with a KNOWN planted bug: a withdraw instruction whose accounts struct does not tie the vault account to its owner (no has_one or seeds constraint), so any signer can withdraw from any vault. Any comment revealing the bug is removed from the copy.
evals.example_fixture: none yet: build one from the vault above by removing its owner constraint
evals.expected_output: Properties include that withdraw moves funds only for the vault's owner. The prover finds the violation; the skill marks the rule expected-to-fail with reason 'genuine issue' and reports it as a finding with the pre-state and the call. It does NOT weaken the rule until it passes, and does NOT skip the property.
assertions: a property that only the vault's owner can withdraw from it exists in the properties artifact
its rule is BAD/VIOLATED in report.json and marked expected-to-fail as a 'genuine issue', not removed and not marked 'prover limitation'
report.md describes the missing owner check as a finding for human review
no rule asserts the buggy behavior or assumes away the missing constraint

evals.name: refuses-a-project-it-cannot-verify
evals.prompt: Please formally verify the Solana program in <project> using the Certora prover.
evals.fixture: A Cargo workspace with two library packages and nothing naming which one is the program, and no Solana dependency in either.
evals.example_fixture: none: two `cargo new --lib` packages in one workspace
evals.expected_output: The skill stops without editing the project or writing rules, and tells the user why: either preflight finds no Anchor or solana-program dependency, or `certora-cvlr setup` refuses and the skill relays its reason. Refusing in preflight is the better outcome when the code already shows there is no Solana program.
assertions: the skill stopped before Phase 2 and gave the user a concrete reason (no Solana program, or setup's refusal)
no Cargo.toml in the fixture was edited and no src/certora/ directory exists
no rules or properties were written
evals.notes: First run, 2026-11-09: stopped in preflight on reading the crates, without building AutoProver; 12 turns. A fixture only setup can refuse is a real solana-program crate on a platform generation outside AutoProver's reference set.
